source.version: Part 17 — Integrated Pest Management, Biosecurity, and Sanitation — Batch 03
source.publicationAuthorization: Project owner authorized continued website publication on 2026-09-01. Independent specialist approval remains a separate project-control field and is not implied by publication.
source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-331–335 add representative scouting, diagnostic escalation, evidence-bounded thresholds/tolerances, cultural controls, and mechanical/physical controls. Public wording preserves sampling denominators and method limitations, separates symptoms and detection from confirmed causation, identifies hemp threshold evidence gaps, and avoids universal Cannabis treatment numbers or physical-control claims.
source.note: This batch advances controlled Volume 17 from observation and diagnosis into documented decisions and nonchemical IPM control categories.
